summary: Your restless side shows up through other people. You may be drawn to the unpredictable, the emotionally unavailable, or people who keep you guessing. Or you become that for someone else.
body: Your restless side shows up through other people. You may be drawn to the unpredictable, the emotionally unavailable, or people who keep you guessing. Or you become that for someone else. The pull between wanting closeness and needing freedom plays out across the table, where you reach for connection and then feel the walls close in. This can make love and chaos feel linked until steadiness becomes familiar. The work is choosing steady on purpose, even when calm feels foreign.
gift: At your best: emotionally honest and free, connected without losing yourself.
shadow: The trap: chasing the unpredictable, then feeling the walls close in.
integration: Build bonds that can breathe. Space works best when it is named, not acted out as distance.
do: Stay when you'd usually pull away
dont: Become the unavailable one to win first
